note: kind=local-private; recommended row. AIA Flexi Plan Standard Private, annual premium age 45: man HK$28,520.00 + woman HK$33,507.20 = HK$62,027.20 a year = HK$5,168.93 a month. measured_for: New South Wales, two adults (a couple, no children), combined hospital and extras policies open to new members; monthly premium before rebate and Lifetime Health Cover loading; median of 399 Silver Plus hospital products with extras, all excess levels
note: kind=local-private; recommended row. Median of the 399 open couple products at Silver Plus hospital tier with extras in the 2 November 2026 official dataset: A$653.80 a month (quartiles A$569.99 to A$747.76; range A$400.40 to A$1,185.47). With an excess of A$500 or less per person: median A$677.01 (245 products). Prices are community rated (no age effect) and the same product list prices differ by state (NSW shown). Not included: the government rebate (nil for a high-income couple) and a Lifetime Health Cover loading of 2% a year for each year after 30 without hospital cover, which applies to new arrivals only after a one-year grace (rule from memory, not saved). Out-patient GP care is paid through Medicare, so extras here mean dental, optical, physiotherapy; cover includes all hospital stays in a private hospital of choice at Silver Plus tier. A hospital policy also exempts the holder from the Medicare levy surcharge.
